body:
# cat ears n meows :3 A silly little mod that adds, well, cat ears and meows :3c ## The cat ears in question: ## The keybind to configure your cat ears :3
## Usage Server paper plugin is still being worked on owo When the mod is on the server (or you're doing singleplayer), there's a crafting recipe to get the cat ears as an item :3 Clientside, cat ears work anywhere but nobody else can see them yet:tm:, just press K :P When enabled, whenever you type in chat, a meow sound plays :3c By default as a *cat*ch-all, every message sends a meow. If you message ends with "!!", then the hissing sound effect plays :P And also if you do "prrr" or ":3c" at the end of your message, then you purr >. ----- ## Happy meowing :3c prrr
